title: Fixed Single-throat Hand Corn Sheller
description: One newly authored complete fixed single-throat hand corn-sheller appearance. A compact foot-supported upright casting carries a large solid toothed shelling disc and an exposed crank. An offset upright open tapered cob throat and a separate curved fixed pressure jaw sit at its left shoulder; a short open outfall passes below the throat. The full support casting, side mouth, solid serrated disc, fixed pressure contour and crank form one machine rather than a chaff trough, open flywheel with blades, coffee grinder or mincer with a changed front plate. One static prop, zero scenes. No kernel separation, cob flow, motion, working spring, crop throughput, food contact, machining, manufacture or safety claim.
